title: George Floyd’s GoFundMe raised $14.7M in 2020; six years later, siblings seek full accounting
summary_full: After George Floyd's untimely death in 2020, a fundraising campaign on GoFundMe amassed millions to support his family. However, his siblings are now pressing for a comprehensive audit of the funds raised, alleging an inequitable distribution of the contributions. They have called on Philonise Floyd to produce various financial records linked to the campaign. This unfolding situation emphasizes the critical importance of accountability in the handling of considerable charitable donations.
